## POST `/api/instances/host/name:{name}/action/modifyHostLUNs`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Modify the Host LUN Identifier (HLU) of one or more LUNs accessible by the host . The method takes a list of hostLUNs, so that the HLUs of one or more LUNs can be changed at once, even if the old and new HLUs overlap.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | Host name: For an automatically-managed ESXi server through vCenter, this is the display name in the vCenter GUI. For a manually-created host , this is the host name entered by the user. |

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `hostLunModifyList` | array of object | List of embedded hostLunModify objects. The embedded object has the required hostLUN details to be updated. |

**Responses:** `204` No Content
